between L 1 and L 2 is 3 and the perpendicular distance between L 2 and L 3 is also 3. A

the area of the square.

30. Consider the areas of the four triangles obtained by drawing the diagonals AC and
BD of a trapezium ABCD. The product of these areas, taken two at time, are computed.
If among the six products so obtained, two products are 1296 and 576, determine the
square root of the maximum possible area of the trapezium to the nearest integer.
